comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight tail cap, remove its battery into a bin, and set the parts down.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold a cylindrical body, turn a threaded cap through a full release, tip out an internal cell, and place components.
comparison.success_condition: Cap genuinely unscrewed and placed safely, battery in the box, flashlight returned outside it, all released and still.
comparison.reason: Shares bimanual counterholding and threaded rotation, but its tested outcome is disassembly and extraction. It does not preserve a calibrated screw position while tightening a concentric jam nut or demonstrate retained motion.
